files.sha256_note: These are the hashes of the JPEGs. An earlier pass of this curation recorded hashes taken BEFORE the magic bytes were checked, and seven of them were the hashes of a Google reCAPTCHA challenge page saved with a .jpg name. A sha256 of an unverified download is a hash of whatever the server felt like sending; the fetcher used here requires a known magic (ffd8ff / %PDF / PK) before it writes a file at all, and the recorded hashes were taken afterwards.
